result.summary: The page appears to be a food delivery app interface. There are no critical issues, but there are a few minor visual and layout inconsistencies that could be improved.

issues.description: The horizontal scrolling category list ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) is cut off on the right edge, suggesting there are more categories not visible without scrolling, but there is no visual cue (like a shadow or arrow) indicating this.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or arrow on the right edge to indicate that the list is scrollable horizontally.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Either allow the text to wrap to a second line or use a tooltip on long press to show the full name.
